DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION- bound {PLAYER}?
DEWFORD's GYM LEADER BRAWLY commands FIGHTING-type POKéMON.
Going against him with NORMAL-type POKéMON is asking for trouble.
FIGHTING POKéMON will lay a serious smack down on NORMAL POKéMON, so be careful!
What's worse, the GYM is as dark as the ocean floor.
But it will get brighter after defeating the TRAINERS in your way.
Hey, okay, go for it!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictory:
Whoah! It's turned too bright in here!
Your future is bright, too!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_TakaoPostBattle: Your skill overcame my strength! Your technique is commendable!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynIntro:
There's no need for BRAWLY to be involved!
I'll crush you!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynDefeat: But… How? How could I lose so easily?
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_JocelynPostBattle:
I'm not going to waste this loss. I'll use it to motivate me to train!
One day I'll become a GYM LEADER…
No, I'll become the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraIntro: Don't you dare brush me off! It's not my fault if you cry!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LauraPostBattle:
I battle in the dark to make my heart stronger.
But because it's so dark, I can never see BRAWLY's face…
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithIntro: Ufufu… Are you stumbling around in the dark?
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithDefeat: Oh, you… I don't want to know you!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_LilithPostBattle: You deserve to stay lost and end up back at the entrance again!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenIntro: I'll show you the gumption of a sailing man!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenDefeat: How'd this happen? It's not like me to lose this way!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrendenPostBattle: Oh, aye! You're worthy of seeing our GYM LEADER.
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianIntro: If you mean to pass, it has to be through me!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_CristianPostBattle: You win! Go after that BADGE!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyIntro:
I'm BRAWLY! DEWFORD's GYM LEADER!
I've been churned in the rough waves of these parts, and I've grown tough in the pitch-black cave!
So you wanted to challenge me? Let me see what you're made of!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyDefeat:
Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger splash than I expected!
You swamped me!
Okay, you've got me. Take this GYM BADGE!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ReceivedKnuckleBadg: {PLAYER} received the KNUCKLE BADGE from BRAWLY.
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_KnuckleBadgeInfoTak:
The KNUCKLE BADGE makes all POKéMON up to Level 30, even those you get in trades, obey without question.
And, you'll be able to use the HM move FLASH outside of battle.
If you'd like, use this TECHNICAL MACHINE, too.
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_ExplainBulkUp:
That TM08 contains BULK UP.
It's a move that raises both ATTACK and DEFENSE stats.
… … … … … …
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_RegisteredBrawly: Registered GYM LEADER BRAWLY in the POKéNAV.
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostBattle: I can see your talent becoming a giant wave to cause a storm of astonishment among TRAINERS one day!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_GymStatueCertified:
DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM
BRAWLY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS: {PLAYER}
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPreRematch:
BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it always returns to the shore.
A giant wave of a talent like you… I knew you would return!
Show me how much higher you've gone!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyPostRematch: BRAWLY: Battling is vast and it's deep. You can't see the bottom. It's just like the sea of HOENN!
DewfordTown_Gym_Text_BrawlyRematchNeedTw:
BRAWLY: A wave may draw back, but it always returns to the shore.
A giant wave of a talent like you… I knew you would return!
Oh? You only have one POKéMON that can battle.
I'm sorry, but I'd like you to come back with at least two POKéMON.
